header.purpose: Design catalog mapping future GitHub write capabilities to read-back verification using only existing CP4 read-only capabilities. Planning only: no production write capability is added in this lane (WRITE_CAPABILITY_REQUIRED=NO).
principles: stdout is at most a locator hint; it must be validated, scope-bound, and followed by a remote readback
exit 0 never proves a remote state change
verification must not create business side effects; only read-only capabilities serve as verifiers
where no trusted read path exists, the catalog marks a gap instead of inventing a solution

mappings.planned_effect: a new issue exists in the target repository
mappings.expected_state: issue with subject owner/repo#<new-number> exists; title/body match the plan inputs
mappings.read_verification_fields: number, title, state, url, created_at, updated_at
mappings.subject_locator: owner/repo from plan inputs plus issue number
mappings.locator_derivation: gh issue create stdout URL is a locator candidate only; the number must be parsed from the validated URL and rebound to owner/repo before readback
mappings.locator_gap_detail: current CP4 trusted result provides stdout text only; there is no trusted structured issue-number field for the created issue. If the number cannot be safely derived from a trusted result, the mapping is LOCATOR_GAP and must not be faked.
mappings.missing_read_capability: none for state; number derivation is the gap
mappings.eventual_consistency: creation is usually immediately visible; still allow the bounded retry budget
mappings.verification_limit: bounded attempts (default evidence rounds) with backoff; constant 404/absence -> NOT_VERIFIED, never default success
mappings.structured_fields_note: readback compares title/state via github.issue.read structured output, never stdout text

mappings.planned_effect: a new comment exists on issue owner/repo#N authored by the expected identity with the expected body
mappings.expected_state: comment list for issue includes the new comment body
mappings.read_verification_fields: number, title, state, state_reason, url, created_at, updated_at
mappings.readback_gap_detail: current github.issue.read output has no comments field, so issue.comment has no complete read-back verifier today. A future read-only comment fetch capability is required; stdout must never be used to prove a comment.
mappings.subject_locator: owner/repo#N plus comment id (future comments.read output)
mappings.eventual_consistency: comments are usually immediately visible; still allow the bounded retry budget
mappings.verification_limit: bounded attempts; gap means verification is not claimable until comments.read exists

mappings.expected_state: github.issue.read returns state CLOSED for the exact subject owner/repo#N
mappings.subject_locator: owner/repo#N from the approved plan inputs (exact subject identity check)
mappings.structured_fields_note: state strings canonicalize (OPEN/CLOSED) before comparison; case/unicode variants must not alias
mappings.eventual_consistency: state transitions are eventually consistent; bounded retries absorb convergence delay
mappings.verification_limit: bounded attempts; final MISMATCH only after budget exhaustion

mappings.expected_state: github.pr.read returns state MERGED for owner/repo#N; optionally merge commit metadata
mappings.read_verification_fields: number, state, mergeable, merge_state_status, created_at, updated_at
mappings.partial_gap_detail: pr.read state MERGED verifies merge state today; merge commit metadata (mergedAt, mergeCommit oid) is not in the current structured output and requires a future read field extension. gh pr merge exit 0 alone never proves a merge.
mappings.subject_locator: owner/repo#N from the approved plan inputs
mappings.structured_fields_note: verification predicate: state == MERGED plus subject identity; metadata predicate only after field extension
mappings.eventual_consistency: merge visibility may lag; bounded retries required
mappings.verification_limit: bounded attempts; MERGED observed within budget verifies; exhausted budget -> MISMATCH/INCONCLUSIVE

catalog_constraints.readback_authority: trusted broker-run readback observation, not stdout, not LLM text
